objects.description: No custom structs, enums, typedefs, or classes are defined in these headers. The files only define macros, function prototypes, and constants for the Blosc C API. Consequently, there are no user-defined types to document.

functions.name: blosc_init
functions.description: Initialize the Blosc library environment. Must be called before any other non-context Blosc calls. In multi-threaded scenarios where Blosc is used simultaneously by multiple threads, prefer exclusively using the context APIs (blosc_compress_ctx/blosc_decompress_ctx) instead of relying on global initialization.
requirements: Call before other global (non-context) Blosc functions when using the global API.
If Blosc will be used simultaneously from multiple threads, do not rely on the global initialization; instead use the context APIs exclusively.

functions.name: blosc_destroy
functions.description: Destroy the Blosc library environment previously set up by blosc_init. Call this when finished using the global Blosc API.
requirements: Call after completing all Blosc operations if blosc_init() was previously called.
If blosc_init() was never called, do not call blosc_destroy().

functions.name: blosc_compress
functions.signature: int blosc_compress(int clevel, int doshuffle, size_t typesize, size_t nbytes, const void *src, void *dest, size_t destsize);
functions.description: Compress a block of data from src of size nbytes into dest, returning the compressed size. clevel is the compression level [0..9]. doshuffle selects filter: BLOSC_NOSHUFFLE, BLOSC_SHUFFLE, or BLOSC_BITSHUFFLE. typesize specifies the atomic element size (used by shuffle). If destsize is at least nbytes + BLOSC_MAX_OVERHEAD, compression is guaranteed to succeed. Returns 0 if data cannot be compressed into destsize; negative on internal error.
requirements: clevel must be in the range 0..9.
doshuffle must be one of BLOSC_NOSHUFFLE, BLOSC_SHUFFLE, BLOSC_BITSHUFFLE.
typesize outside 1<typesize<256 disables shuffle filters silently; 1<typesize<256 is required for shuffle to be effective.
src and dest buffers must not overlap.
dest must reference at least destsize bytes; function will not write beyond destsize.
To guarantee success, destsize must be at least nbytes + BLOSC_MAX_OVERHEAD.
Maximum supported source size is limited by BLOSC_MAX_BUFFERSIZE.
Function is memory-safe and does not write past destsize.
A return value of 0 means not enough space in dest; negative return indicates an internal error.

functions.name: blosc_compress_ctx
functions.signature: int blosc_compress_ctx(int clevel, int doshuffle, size_t typesize, size_t nbytes, const void* src, void* dest, size_t destsize, const char* compressor, size_t blocksize, int numinternalthreads);
functions.description: Context-based compression that avoids the global lock and does not require blosc_init. Same semantics as blosc_compress, plus selecting a compressor by name, an optional blocksize (0 for automatic), and the number of internal threads.
requirements: Same buffer and sizing requirements as blosc_compress (non-overlapping src/dest; dest must be at least destsize; to guarantee success destsize >= nbytes + BLOSC_MAX_OVERHEAD).
clevel must be in the range 0..9.
doshuffle must be one of BLOSC_NOSHUFFLE, BLOSC_SHUFFLE, BLOSC_BITSHUFFLE.
typesize outside 1<typesize<256 disables shuffle filters silently.
compressor must be a valid compressor name supported by the build (e.g., "blosclz", "lz4", "lz4hc", "snappy", "zlib", "zstd").
blocksize of 0 selects an automatic blocksize; other values are allowed but may have important restrictions (not detailed here).
numinternalthreads specifies the number of internal threads to use.
Returns negative on internal error.

functions.name: blosc_decompress
functions.signature: int blosc_decompress(const void *src, void *dest, size_t destsize);
functions.description: Decompress a compressed buffer at src into dest, writing at most destsize bytes. Returns the number of decompressed bytes on success; returns 0 or a negative value on error (e.g., corrupt data or dest too small). Call blosc_cbuffer_validate to determine required destination size before decompressing.
requirements: src and dest buffers must not overlap.
dest must reference at least destsize bytes; function will not write past destsize.
Use blosc_cbuffer_validate to obtain the uncompressed size to size dest appropriately.
On error, the function returns 0 or a negative value; callers must handle these cases.

functions.name: blosc_decompress_ctx
functions.signature: int blosc_decompress_ctx(const void *src, void *dest, size_t destsize, int numinternalthreads);
functions.description: Context-based decompression that avoids the global lock and does not require blosc_init. Same semantics as blosc_decompress with an explicit number of internal threads.
requirements: src and dest buffers must not overlap.
dest must reference at least destsize bytes; the function will not write past destsize.
Use blosc_cbuffer_validate to obtain the uncompressed size to size dest appropriately.
numinternalthreads specifies the number of internal threads to use.
On error (e.g., corrupt data or dest too small), returns 0 or a negative value; callers must handle these cases.

functions.name: blosc_getitem
functions.signature: int blosc_getitem(const void *src, int start, int nitems, void *dest);
functions.description: Extract nitems items (using the itemsize stored in the compressed buffer) starting at item index start from the compressed buffer src and copy them to dest. Returns the number of bytes copied or a negative value on error.
requirements: dest must have enough space for nitems items (nitems * typesize bytes).
start and nitems must designate a valid range within the uncompressed data; specific bounds are not documented here.
src must be a valid blosc-compressed buffer.

functions.name: blosc_get_nthreads
functions.description: Return the current number of threads used for compression/decompression in the global API.

functions.name: blosc_set_nthreads
functions.description: Initialize or reconfigure the thread pool for compression/decompression. If nthreads is 1, selects the serial version and ends any existing pool. Returns the previous number of threads.
requirements: nthreads specifies the number of threads to use; value 1 selects serial mode.

functions.name: blosc_get_compressor
functions.description: Return the name of the current compressor used for compression in the global API.

functions.name: blosc_set_compressor
functions.description: Select the compressor to be used by name ("blosclz", "lz4", "lz4hc", "snappy", "zlib", or "zstd"). Returns the compressor code (>=0) on success or -1 if the compressor is not recognized or not supported by this build.
requirements: compname must be a recognized and supported compressor name for this build.

functions.name: blosc_compcode_to_compname
functions.description: Get the compressor name associated with a compressor code. On success returns the compressor code (>=0) and sets *compname to the name; returns -1 if the code is not recognized or not supported in this build.
requirements: compname must be a valid pointer to receive the resulting name (non-NULL).
compcode must refer to a recognized/supported compressor; otherwise -1 is returned.

functions.name: blosc_compname_to_compcode
functions.description: Return the compressor code associated with a compressor name, or -1 if the name is not recognized or not supported in this build.
requirements: compname must name a recognized/supported compressor for success.

functions.name: blosc_list_compressors
functions.description: Return a comma-separated list of compressors supported in the current build. The returned string is owned by the library and must not be freed by the caller.
requirements: Do not free() the returned string.

functions.name: blosc_get_version_string
functions.description: Return the C-Blosc library version in string format. Useful for dynamic libraries.

functions.name: blosc_get_complib_info
functions.description: Retrieve information about a compressor library. Given a compressor name, returns its library code (>=0) and, if requested, allocated strings for the compressor library name and version. Caller must free() the returned strings when non-NULL. Returns -1 if the compressor is not supported.
requirements: compname must name a compressor recognized by the build for success.
If complib is non-NULL and the compressor is supported, *complib will be set to a heap-allocated string that the caller must free().
If version is non-NULL and the compressor is supported, *version will be set to a heap-allocated string that the caller must free().
If complib or version arguments are NULL, they will not be assigned, and the caller must not attempt to free them.

functions.name: blosc_free_resources
functions.description: Free temporary memory and thread resources held by the library. Returns 0 on success or a negative value on failure. Useful when Blosc will not be used for a long time.

functions.name: blosc_cbuffer_sizes
functions.signature: void blosc_cbuffer_sizes(const void *cbuffer, size_t *nbytes, size_t *cbytes, size_t *blocksize);
functions.description: Return information about a compressed buffer: uncompressed size (nbytes), compressed size (cbytes), and internal blocksize. Only the first BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes of cbuffer are required. If the format is not supported by the library, all outputs are set to zero.
requirements: cbuffer must reference at least BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes of the compressed buffer.
nbytes, cbytes, and blocksize must be valid pointers (non-NULL) to receive results.

functions.name: blosc_cbuffer_validate
functions.signature: int blosc_cbuffer_validate(const void* cbuffer, size_t cbytes, size_t* nbytes);
functions.description: Validate that the buffer starting at cbuffer with length cbytes may contain valid Blosc-compressed data and that calling decompression/getitem would be safe to attempt. On success, returns 0 and sets *nbytes to the uncompressed size; on failure, returns -1. Validation does not guarantee decompression will succeed, only that it is safe to try.
requirements: cbuffer must reference at least cbytes bytes of input.
nbytes must be a valid pointer (non-NULL) to receive the uncompressed size.
Caller should check for a 0 return to proceed and -1 for failure.

functions.name: blosc_cbuffer_metainfo
functions.description: Return meta-information about a compressed buffer: the element typesize and internal flags. Flags bits: bit 0 (BLOSC_DOSHUFFLE), bit 1 (BLOSC_MEMCPYED), bit 2 (BLOSC_DOBITSHUFFLE). Only the first BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes of cbuffer are required. If the format is not supported, outputs are set to zero.
requirements: cbuffer must reference at least BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes of the compressed buffer.
typesize and flags must be valid pointers (non-NULL).

functions.name: blosc_cbuffer_versions
functions.description: Return the internal Blosc format version and the compressor format version used in a compressed buffer. This function should always succeed.
requirements: version and compversion must be valid pointers (non-NULL).
cbuffer must reference the compressed buffer.

functions.name: blosc_cbuffer_complib
functions.description: Return the compressor library/format used in a compressed buffer.
requirements: cbuffer must reference the compressed buffer.

functions.name: blosc_get_blocksize
functions.description: Return the internal blocksize to be used during compression. A value of 0 means an automatic blocksize is computed (default).

functions.name: blosc_set_blocksize
functions.description: Force the use of a specific blocksize for compression. A value of 0 restores automatic blocksize selection. The blocksize parameter has important restrictions in allowed values; use with care.
requirements: blocksize of 0 selects automatic block sizing; non-zero values must comply with internal restrictions (not detailed here).

functions.name: blosc_set_splitmode
functions.description: Set the block split mode used by the compressor. Supported values: BLOSC_FORWARD_COMPAT_SPLIT, BLOSC_AUTO_SPLIT, BLOSC_NEVER_SPLIT, BLOSC_ALWAYS_SPLIT. Default (if not set) is BLOSC_FORWARD_COMPAT_SPLIT. Intended for controlling forward compatibility and compression heuristics.
requirements: splitmode must be one of BLOSC_FORWARD_COMPAT_SPLIT, BLOSC_AUTO_SPLIT, BLOSC_NEVER_SPLIT, or BLOSC_ALWAYS_SPLIT.

data_types.description: A raw byte buffer with no format constraints. May contain any values including NUL bytes and non-UTF-8 sequences. Used as generic input payloads for compression or as source material to create valid compressed buffers in tests.

generators.generator:
import os
import random
import struct

# Generator for arbitrary binary data tailored to Blosc fuzz stubs
# Goals:
# - Produce diverse, but valid, "plain" buffers for compression paths.
# - Include patterns that exercise shuffle/bitshuffle effectiveness (various typesizes),
#   as well as incompressible/random, highly compressible (runs/zeros), and structured data.
# - Keep size within 1..1024 bytes (stubs clamp to 1024) and under 4096 overall.
# - Deterministic with provided seed, but still varied across calls.


def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    # Use getrandbits for speed and determinism
    # Generate in chunks of 8 bytes
    out = bytearray()
    for _ in range((n + 7) // 8):
        v = rng.getrandbits(64)
        out.extend(v.to_bytes(8, 'little'))
    return bytes(out[:n])


offset_patterns = [
    # Each entry is a function producing bytes of length n
    # Pattern 0: all zeros (max compressibility)
    lambda rng, n: b"\x00" * n,
    # Pattern 1: all 0xFF
    lambda rng, n: b"\xFF" * n,
    # Pattern 2: ascending bytes 0..255 repeating
    lambda rng, n: bytes((i % 256 for i in range(n))),
    # Pattern 3: descending bytes 255..0 repeating
    lambda rng, n: bytes(((255 - (i % 256)) for i in range(n))),
    # Pattern 4: random bytes (low compressibility)
    lambda rng, n: _rand_bytes(rng, n),
    # Pattern 5: repeated short token (RLE-like)
    lambda rng, n: (b"AB" * ((n + 1) // 2))[:n],
    # Pattern 6: repeated 4-byte word pattern for typesize=4 shuffle
    lambda rng, n: (struct.pack('<I', 0x11223344) * ((n + 3) // 4))[:n],
    # Pattern 7: repeated 8-byte word pattern for typesize=8 shuffle
    lambda rng, n: (struct.pack('<Q', 0x0102030405060708) * ((n + 7) // 8))[:n],
    # Pattern 8: sine-like waveform bytes
    lambda rng, n: bytes(int(127 + 127 * __import__('math').sin(i / 7.0)) & 0xFF for i in range(n)),
    # Pattern 9: small alphabet text-like data
    lambda rng, n: (b"ACGT" * ((n + 3) // 4))[:n],
    # Pattern 10: blocks of zeros and random alternating to test block splits
    lambda rng, n: _blocks_zeros_random(rng, n),
    # Pattern 11: increasing 32-bit little-endian integers
    lambda rng, n: _le_u32_sequence(n),
    # Pattern 12: increasing 64-bit little-endian integers
    lambda rng, n: _le_u64_sequence(n),
]


def _blocks_zeros_random(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    while len(out) < n:
        # zero block
        zlen = rng.randint(8, 64)
        out.extend(b"\x00" * zlen)
        if len(out) >= n:
            break
        # random block
        rlen = rng.randint(8, 64)
        out.extend(_rand_bytes(rng, rlen))
    return bytes(out[:n])


def _le_u32_sequence(n: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    val = 0
    while len(out) + 4 <= n:
        out.extend(struct.pack('<I', val))
        val += 1
    # tail
    rem = n - len(out)
    if rem:
        out.extend(struct.pack('<I', val)[:rem])
    return bytes(out)


def _le_u64_sequence(n: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    val = 0
    while len(out) + 8 <= n:
        out.extend(struct.pack('<Q', val))
        val += 1
    rem = n - len(out)
    if rem:
        out.extend(struct.pack('<Q', val)[:rem])
    return bytes(out)


def _mix_typesize_columns(rng: random.Random, base: bytes, typesize: int) -> bytes:
    # For shuffle-relevant patterns, interleave columns per typesize to create columnar regularity
    if typesize <= 1:
        return base
    n = len(base)
    # Create columns with small deltas to be highly compressible post-shuffle
    cols = [bytearray(n // typesize + (1 if i < (n % typesize) else 0)) for i in range(typesize)]
    for i, col in enumerate(cols):
        # choose a base and step per column
        b = rng.randrange(256)
        step = rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 4, 8])
        for j in range(len(col)):
            col[j] = (b + j * step) & 0xFF
    # interleave back
    out = bytearray(n)
    idxs = [0] * typesize
    for i in range(n):
        t = i % typesize
        out[i] = cols[t][idxs[t]]
        idxs[t] += 1
    return bytes(out)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Length choice: favor small to moderate sizes but include edge extremes
    choices = [1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 15, 16, 31, 32, 63, 64, 127, 128, 255, 256, 511, 512, 768, 1000, 1024]
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        n = rng.choice(choices)
    else:
        n = rng.randint(1, 1024)

    # Select a base pattern
    pattern_fn = rng.choice(offset_patterns)
    data = pattern_fn(rng, n)

    # Optionally apply a shuffle-friendly columnar tweak for random/incompressible bases
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        # pick a typesize commonly used with Blosc
        ts = rng.choice([1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32])
        data = _mix_typesize_columns(rng, data, ts)

    # Occasionally add a small deterministic header or footer to vary early bytes
    tweak = rng.random()
    if tweak < 0.2 and n >= 8:
        # Prefix small header-like marker (not a real Blosc header, just variety)
        header = struct.pack('<IHB', 0xA1B2C3D4, 0x55AA, 0x7F)
        buf = bytearray(data)
        m = min(len(header), len(buf))
        buf[:m] = header[:m]
        data = bytes(buf)
    elif tweak < 0.4 and n >= 8:
        # Suffix marker
        footer = b"\xDE\xAD\xBE\xEF\x00\x11\x22\x33"
        buf = bytearray(data)
        m = min(len(footer), len(buf))
        buf[-m:] = footer[:m]
        data = bytes(buf)

    # Ensure within 4096 bytes
    return data[:4096]
